name: Ember and ash
one_line: Black rock, falling ash and one river of orange.
look_words: A volcanic land after the fire. Charcoal and soot-brown rock, grey ash on every ledge, dead black trees, a heavy red-brown sky. Lava is the only bright thing in the world and it means harm, so its orange is never used for anything else. Things to collect and the goal are cool: pale cyan and pale gold, the opposite of the fire. The player is pale grey, like ash-covered cloth, and reads against the black rock. Light is dim and comes from below, with warm bounce from the lava on the undersides of things. Shapes are jagged and cracked. Motion is slow and heavy: ash falling like snow, embers rising, lava creeping. Avoid red fog over everything, glow on rocks, purple, and bloom that washes out the lava.

palette.name: ember and ash
palette.notes: Danger is the lava orange. The ground bounce is a dark red so undersides glow faintly, as if lit from below.

look_wish: soft painterly shading with tight glows, or none

upgrade.why: real flames you can walk around
paints molten cracks along any surface (reference only: read it, then build your own)

music.mood: low drums, deep brass and a rumble

sound_feel: rumbles, hiss of steam, crackle, rock cracking
